notes.title: Hold your Вefence
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Transition to Unreal Engine 5.1[/b][/h1]

[b]Added:[/b]

New game interface.
New game mode-Defense.
Three new maps.
New barricades.
Improved gun shop.
Command hint system. 
Now players can see the health, ammo and money of teammates.
Added highlighting system for remaining zombies on the map.
Added a melee attack that knocks back enemies. The default button is "V".

[b]Fixed:[/b]

Fixed economy in game 
Fixed bug with grenade.
Fixed a bug with a spitter-он больше не стреляет через стены.
Fixed AI for regular zombies so they can now surround the player and jump off ledges.
Fixed a bug when a player holds a weapon during a knockout.
Fixed a bug with falling through textures on some maps.
Fixed ammo count for all weapons.


Further updates will coming soon. Thank for feedback and assistant for developers!

notes.title: Bug Fixed
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug with weapons dropping after death.
Fixed claymore mine
Fixed a bug where after death the player was holding multiple weapons
Reduced the attack radius, attack area and attack speed of regular mutants.
Fixed collision issue on Gloomy Factory map
